subject: VPC pricing & support slab — platform fee annualization and onboarding credit options
messages:
From: Clara Soto <clara.soto@optihealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: OptiHealth Procurement <procurement@optihealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: VPC pricing — platform fee amortization + support slab question

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — OptiHealth leadership liked the latency profile and the private deployment checklist. We need to firm up commercials to present to our finance committee next Wednesday. A few items to confirm: 

- Can the platform fee be amortized monthly across the term rather than invoiced up-front?
- We expect a phased roll-out: pilot (single region) for 3 months, then multi-region (US + EU) at scale. Any discount/credits for staged deployment?
- Support: can you share a clear mapping of support slabs (Standard, Premier) and what’s included (SLA, response times, on-call hours)?
- Any onboarding/implementation credit or reduced professional services if we commit to a 12–24 month term?

Attached is our initial security and procurement checklist request — happy to share more if helpful.

Can we get a short note with options by EOD Thursday so we can include in the prep deck?

Best,
Clara
Head of Platform Partnerships
OptiHealth

Attachment: OptiHealth_RFP_Checklist.pdf (see referenced items)

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Soto <clara.soto@optihealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VPC pricing — platform fee amortization + support slab question

Hi Clara —

Appreciate the clear list. High level options below; I can put numbers into a short quote once you confirm expected token volumes and whether reserved capacity (nodes) will be required for the multi-region phase.

1) Platform fee billing:
   - One-time: full platform fee upfront (standard).
   - Amortized: we can amortize the platform fee monthly over the contract term for terms >= 12 months. Pricing impact: small financing uplift applies (we absorb admin spread for 12-months; longer terms get better effective rate).

2) Staged deployment credits:
   - Pilot credit: 10% credit on platform fee for a single-region 90-day pilot when you convert to committed term within 60 days of pilot end.
   - Multi-region add-on: 5% recurring discount on committed node pricing for second region when provisioned within initial 6 months.

3) Support slabs:
   - Standard: 24x5 support, 24-hour response for Sev1, access to knowledge base and quarterly health checks.
   - Premier: 24x7 support, 4-hour response Sev1, 1 named technical account manager (TAM), monthly operational reviews, includes 8 hours/month of on-call engineering time for runbook changes.

4) Onboarding credits / PS:
   - For a 12-month commit: up to $30k implementation credit (applied against first invoice) + discounted PS rates.
   - For 24-month commit or reserved capacity: up to $60k credit and a dedicated on-site week (if needed).

Next steps: if you can share a 12‑month expected token/embedding volume and whether you want reserved nodes in EU+US, I’ll circulate a formal quote and a draft SOW. I’m also attaching our SOC2 report and a sample SOW.

Would a 30-minute alignment call tomorrow at 10am PT work?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf; Draft_SOW_OptiHealth_v1.docx

From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: OPT-2026-0092 — discount posture & amortization guidance

Vanessa / Dylan —

Saw Vanessa’s reply to OptiHealth. A couple of guardrails from finance / commercial: 

- Amortization: Finance will accept monthly amortization for platform fee only on minimum 12‑month fully-paid commitments. For 12 months we can offer amortization with a 3% uplift; for 24 months, 0% uplift.
- Pilot credit: OK to offer a 10% pilot credit but tie it to conversion (convert within 60 days).
- Onboarding credit: we should position PS credit as time-limited and capped; $30k for 12m, $60k for 24m is acceptable if they commit to an annual spend floor (define floor together).
- Support slabs: Premier must be quoted as an add-on SKU with TAM hours visible; don’t bundle unlimited on-call in baseline.

If OptiHealth pushes for upfront invoice reduction, propose: 50% upfront platform fee, 50% amortized over remaining term for 12m deals. That protects cash while giving them flexibility.

I’ll draft the quote template — Dylan, please run a reserved node/price example for 3x A100 equivalent nodes across two regions (US/EU) and include the 5% multi-region add-on discount.

Lauren
Head of Commercial Operations

From: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: OPT-2026-0092 — reserved capacity example & tradeoffs

Lauren / team —

Attached a quick cost sketch (numbers illustrative) for 3 reserved nodes (A100 equiv) US + EU:

- Base reserved price (per region): $90k/month for 3 nodes.
- With multi-region 5% discount applied to nodes: $85.5k/month in second region.
- Platform fee (annualized over 12 months): $48k/yr -> amortized $4k/mo (with 3% uplift per Lauren).
- Onboarding credit: $30k (applied to first invoice).

Commercial trigger: If OptiHealth goes 24m and commits node reservation we can increase onboarding credit to $60k and waive the amortization uplift. If they require net-30 invoicing terms longer than 60 days, need finance sign-off and likely contract CLA.

I’ll incorporate these figures into a draft quote. Vanessa — happy to join the alignment call to walk through the numbers.

Dylan
Solutions Pricing

From: Clara Soto <clara.soto@optihealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: OptiHealth Procurement <procurement@optihealth.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VPC pricing — platform fee amortization + support slab question

Thanks — this is really helpful.

Quick responses: 
- We expect ~450M tokens/month in pilot (synthetic estimate) and ~2.2B tokens/month at scale. Reserved capacity likely needed at scale, but pilot can run on shared with a reserved pilot node.
- We prefer amortization monthly if possible; 12-month term is our target but willing to discuss 24-month for better economics.
- Premier support looks necessary given our SLAs; please include TAM hours and a clear monthly SKU price.

Next steps: please send the short quote + revised SOW with the 12m and 24m options and the two commercial scenarios (1) 12m amortized + $30k onboarding credit, (2) 24m reserved nodes + $60k credit and waived uplift. Also include the SOC2 report you mentioned and any compliance evidence we can re-send to our security team.

If you can have the quote and draft SOW by COB Monday we’ll route to procurement and finance. We’ll target a brief sync early next week if needed.

Regards,
Clara
Head of Platform Partnerships
OptiHealth

Quoted attachments requested: Draft_SOW_OptiHealth_v1.docx; Redwood_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf
